description: Whether a transaction you sent on Base is pending, mined or reverted, the gas it cost, and what it did in CoinFactory terms: a launch (and whether it's registered yet), a trade of a CoinFactory token with its fill, an approval, or a reward claim with the ETH paid. Use it after sending each step from the build tools instead of guessing from market data, which lags by about a minute. Read-only.
name: get_transaction_status
title: Check a transaction
